settings.lede: AACollectibles is a two-person card counter dealing Pokémon, One Piece and Riftbound singles, graded slabs and sealed product. Every raw card is checked under a loupe and photographed before it goes in the case — the card in the photo is the card you get.

settings.heading: Pick your side of the case
settings.say: Singles priced off current market, sealed priced off what we paid. Each game gets its own room — sets, singles and sealed, all in one place.

settings.heading: In the case right now
settings.say: Fresh intake, listed Tuesday. Raw singles are Near Mint or better — anything with whitening or a print line gets binned, not listed.

settings.heading: How a card gets to you
settings.say: The same four steps for a $3 common and a four-figure slab.

settings.title: Loupe check
settings.body: Every raw single goes under 10× magnification — edge whitening, print lines, surface scratches, centering front and back. Anything that won't grade Near Mint doesn't make it to the site.

settings.title: Condition call & photos
settings.body: Graded on the standard scale — NM, LP, MP — then shot front and back on a neutral card. No stock images, ever: the card in the listing photo is the exact card that ships.

settings.title: Packed like it's ours
settings.body: Penny sleeve, toploader, team bag, then a rigid mailer. Slabs get bubble-wrapped in a box. Orders over $200 ship signature-required at no extra charge.

settings.title: Out the same day
settings.body: Orders placed before 3:00 PM ship that afternoon, Monday to Friday. Tracking hits your inbox the moment the label scans.

settings.heading: Got a binder collecting dust?
settings.body: Send photos of the pages, or bring the whole shoebox to the counter. We buy Pokémon, One Piece and Riftbound collections of any size — bulk, binders, sealed cases, and single high-end cards.

settings.heading: Know before the box sells out
settings.say: One email per drop — set releases, sealed restocks, and anything notable that lands in the case.
